verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy documents concrete routing policies matching the story: load balancing across deployments, automatic fallback to a healthy backup model/provider on failure, and content-policy-specific fallbacks mapped across providers — all confirmed by community commentary on its origin as a fix for manual multi-provider if/else logic. Missing for 10: explicit cost-triggered routing (switching to cheaper model based on budget threshold) and any hands-on demonstration of live mid-task switching rather than static failover/fallback configuration.
